# Blue Canvas
> AI consultancy helping UK and Irish businesses integrate artificial intelligence. Based in Derry, Northern Ireland. Delivering globally.

## Services
- AI Audits: Comprehensive AI readiness assessment for businesses (£750)
- AI Strategy and Implementation: Custom AI solutions tailored to your business
- AI Training Workshops: Hands-on team training for organisations of all sizes
- Automation Consulting: Zapier, Make, n8n workflow automation
- AI Academy: Self-paced AI learning programme (£250)
- AI Mentoring: Ongoing monthly AI support (£50/month)

## Industries
- Construction, Healthcare, Education, Legal, Accountancy, Dentistry, Retail, Tourism, Enterprise

## About
Blue Canvas is a Northern Ireland-based AI consultancy founded by Phil Patterson in 2025. We help businesses from SMEs to enterprises adopt AI practically. No jargon, no hype, just measurable results. We are a network of AI consultants delivering across the UK and Ireland.
